known.via: English Wikipedia "Vera de Estenas" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago of the Vera de Estenas winery in Valencia, lying within the Utiel-Requena DO. Its rules allow wine from Bobal, Tempranillo, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay.
